FREE · Every 4 weeks
Why join
OPEN TO EVERYONE
AT IAMS
01
No coding needed

Chinese or English is enough to get started. AI tools are accessible to all staff and researchers at IAMS.

02
Share & learn together

Monthly lunches where members present tools, techniques and projects. Ask questions, find collaborators.

03
Institute AI access

Sign up to try AI tools supported by Academia Sinica. The institute provides access — we help you use it.

04
All roles welcome

From administration staff to PIs — SAIL is for the entire institute. Everyone has something to share and learn.

05
Free lunch

Come for the AI knowledge, stay for the meal. We provide lunch — just bring an open mind and a question.

06
Present your work

Have a tool or technique worth sharing with the institute? Contact the organizers to get on the schedule.
